transcript: Someone just got four interview calls in 24 hours using just three simple ChatGPT prompts that most people don't even know about. First, paste this prompt into ChatGPT. It gives your resume a score out of 100, shows your top five missing keywords, and points out three red flags a hiring manager would notice in 10 seconds. Now, here's the interesting part. Use this prompt and it will rewrite your whole experience section and add the exact keywords. Now, paste this third prompt and it turns into ATS mode, a hiring manager checking 200 resumes, fixing whatever part was getting skipped. Follow me and comment "Resume" and I'll send you all the prompts in your DM.
caption:
